<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1590789_bases.BasesUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>BasesUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var BasesUtils = Class.create();
BasesUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

	getAvailableManagers: function() {

		var managers = [];
		var userGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_has_role');

		userGr.addEncodedQuery('role.nameSTARTSWITHx_1590789_bases.base_manager');
		userGr.query();

		while (userGr.next()) {
			managers.push(userGr.user.sys_id.toString());
		}

		var baseGr = new GlideRecord('x_1590789_bases_base_registration');
		baseGr.query();

		while (baseGr.next()) {
			if (managers.includes(baseGr.base_manager.sys_id.toString())) {
				managers = managers.filter(function(item) {
				return item !== baseGr.base_manager.sys_id.toString(); 
			});
		}
		}

		return "sys_idIN" + managers.join(",");

	},


	getAvailableBases: function(currentUserId) {
        var userId = currentUserId;
        var basesWithAvaliablesSpace = [];
		
		gs.info(userId);

        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1590789_bases_base_registration');
        gr.addQuery('available_spaces', '>', 0);
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            basesWithAvaliablesSpace.push(gr.getValue('sys_id'));
        }

        var grRegistration = new GlideRecord('x_1590789_bases_user_registration');
        grRegistration.addQuery('opened_by', userId);
        grRegistration.addQuery('state', '!=', "4") ;
        grRegistration.query();

        return grRegistration.hasNext() ? 'sys_idIN'+ "6816f79cc0a8016401c5a33be04be441" : "sys_idIN" + basesWithAvaliablesSpace.join(",");
    },

    type: 'BasesUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-02-28 18:19:37</sys_created_on><sys_id>6e5aba3c838862106b4ccad6feaad307</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>BasesUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Bases" source="x_1590789_bases">09142b3f837712106b4ccad6feaad37d</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Bases">09142b3f837712106b4ccad6feaad37d</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_6e5aba3c838862106b4ccad6feaad307</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-02-28 18:19:37</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
